dependedOn: prisma, animeService, mangaService, movieService, tvService, statsService

privateVars.name: loader
privateVars.description: Loader instance that manages connection provider instances

privateVars.name: activeImports
privateVars.type: Map<string, { total: number; processed: number; status: string; error?: string; failedItems?: object[] }>
privateVars.description: Tracks active background import jobs by user-provider key

privateVars.name: prisma
privateVars.description: Prisma database service for connection and user list queries

privateVars.name: animeService
privateVars.description: Service used to ensure anime records exist during import

privateVars.name: mangaService
privateVars.description: Service used to ensure manga records exist during import

privateVars.name: movieService
privateVars.description: Service used to ensure movie records exist during import

privateVars.name: tvService
privateVars.description: Service used to ensure TV records exist during import

privateVars.name: statsService
privateVars.description: Service used to recalculate user stats after import completes

functions.name: onModuleInit
functions.description: Initializes the ConnectionLoader with Prisma, API URL, and env variables, then loads all connection providers

functions.name: toProvider
functions.description: Validates and converts a provider string to a ConnectionProvider enum value

functions.name: getConnectionInstance
functions.description: Retrieves a connection provider instance by ID, validating it exists and is enabled

functions.name: getAuthUrl
functions.description: Gets the OAuth authorization URL from the specified connection provider

functions.name: handleCallback
functions.description: Handles the OAuth callback by exchanging the code for tokens via the provider

functions.name: findAll
functions.description: Finds all connections for a user, optionally filtered by linkedTo and provider capabilities

functions.name: upsert

params.name: data
params.type: { provider: string; linkedUsername?: string; accessToken?: string; refreshToken?: string; expiresAt?: Date; connectionId?: string; linkedTo?: ConnectionLinkedTo; private?: boolean; metadata?: any }

functions.description: Creates or updates a connection record for a user by provider

functions.name: remove
functions.description: Removes a connection record by username and provider

functions.name: getImportStatus
functions.description: Returns the current status of an active or completed import job
returnValues: { total: number; processed: number; status: string; error?: string; failedItems?: object[] }

functions.name: startImport
functions.description: Starts a background import job for the user's media lists from the specified provider

exceptions.name: rrBadRequestException
exceptions.message: Provider ${providerId} does not support importing lists

functions.name: runImportInBackground
functions.description: Runs the full import pipeline in the background: fetches user list, resolves IDs, ensures media records, upserts user list entries, syncs watched episodes, and recalculates stats

functions.name: mergeConnections
functions.description: Merges new connection data into existing connections object for a user list entry

functions.name: resolveMalToAnilistIds
functions.description: Resolves a batch of MAL IDs to AniList IDs via the AniList GraphQL API with rate limit handling
